bio: Zulte-Waregem football club has hired a new striker! In the southern stand, David Bertolozzi hits the bullseye every time with his generous dishes. Start with a range of snacks to share, like generous nuggets of plaice dipped in tartare sauce, before digging into a modern version of classical recipes, such as pheasant with winter side dishes or a heart-warming vol-au-vent. Attractive lunchtime menu....
